name: Kairyuu no Uzu
source:
A young man of Uniconian tribe is running away from humans. He regains consciousness in the church among nuns. He is picked up because resembles a childhood friend of one nun. The young man tries to live in this church to get away from racial prejudice and to atone for his sin of killing a human. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名独角族年轻人正逃避人类。他在修女们所在的教会醒来。由于长得像某位修女的童年朋友，他被收留。为了躲避种族偏见，也为了赎清杀死一名人类的罪孽，这名年轻人试着在教会生活下去。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
